**widen default agent-marker list beyond AI_AGENT**

resolveActorKind() consulted only AI_AGENT unless brain.agentEnv named others (audit finding M4, RULED 2026-09-12: an agent session must be recorded as an agent, never a human). Added AGENT_ENV_DEFAULTS (AI_AGENT, CLAUDECODE, CODEX_THREAD_ID, each commented with runtime + verification) and switched resolveActorKind's default to it. brain.agentEnv still wins over the defaults; set-but-blank still counts as absent with that fact in evidence (#888 discipline); evidence still names the deciding marker. Investigated #461 (source citing an undeclared issue fabricates issue on round-trip) and found no code fix is possible without a prior architecture decision the issue itself defers (new doctrine marker, or a validation rule already ruled out on PR #460) -- documented under openspec/changes/issue-939-461-provenance/, no code changed for #461.
